title: Risk-controlling prediction (CRC/LTT) with cluster-aware UCB
protocol: Learn-then-Test (Angelopoulos et al.) on symmetric accept/reject threshold t; risk = marginal false-accept P(accept AND bad); UCBs: cluster-Hoeffding, Maurer-Pontil empirical-Bernstein, cluster bootstrap over K=7 clips; union correction over the grid; LOCO-honest check (select t on 6 clips, evaluate the 7th)
exchangeability_note: clips are the proposed exchangeable unit; window-level concentration (Bentkus/exact-binomial over n=150) is anti-conservative because of intra-clip correlation (design-effect n_eff(clip))

cluster_floor.note: K=7 exchangeable clips: a nonparametric cluster UCB cannot certify r=0.05 at delta=0.1; the floor is the min UCB over t

frontier_table.assumption: exchangeable WINDOWS -- violated under clip correlation (optimistic)
K=7 clips; a bootstrap over 7 all-zero clusters is anti-conservative (descriptive only)

frontier_table.assumption: clips exchangeable (honest) -- guarantee is data-limited by K, not the tail bound
